name: Quartermaster Lewis
summary: At Sentinel Hill in Westfall, Quartermaster Lewis keeps supplies moving to the People's Militia. He serves local defenders and travelers holding the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: Keeper of the Tower's Stores
sections.body: Quartermaster Lewis keeps the militia's supplies in Sentinel Tower. Stormwind's royal leaders offer little aid to impoverished Westfall, so Sentinel Hill depends on local volunteers and whatever provisions they can gather. Lewis hands out field necessities, including dry rations, fresh water, arrows, shot, and throwing blades. The fighters standing watch need these basics to endure Defias raids.

faq.answer: Quartermaster Lewis serves at Sentinel Tower in Westfall. He handles everyday supplies, rations, and weapons for the People's Militia and adventurers helping defend the region.
Quartermaster Lewis sells basic goods for survival, including bread, milk, water, bags, flint, arrows, bullets, and throwing daggers.

faq.q: What is his role in regional quests?
faq.answer: With little aid from Stormwind, Lewis sends adventurers through Thor, the gryphon master, to deliver a note to Osric Strang, his armor supplier in Stormwind's Old Town, and bring Osric's crate of armor back to Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: Is Lewis part of the Stormwind Army?
faq.answer: Lewis serves the People's Militia, as do most defenders in Sentinel Hill, rather than an official force sent by the Stormwind crown. Westfall has been left largely to defend itself against the Defias Brotherhood.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit in Westfall, you can resupply with Lewis in hostile country where crown resources are scarce.
As a Hunter, you can get field supplies from Lewis in central Westfall, including shot and arrows for ranged defense.
